name: Fracture Malunion
definition: Healing of a fracture in a suboptimal position producing angulation, rotation, shortening or articular incongruity that may impair function.

investigations.principle: Standing/alignment radiographs and CT are used according to deformity and joint involvement.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Corrective osteotomy is considered when deformity causes meaningful pain, dysfunction or future joint risk.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna-vakrata phenotype may be documented after modern alignment assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Healing of a fracture in a suboptimal position producing angulation, rotation, shortening or articular incongruity that may impair function.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
